problem: An adapter completing after disposal could cause the checkpoint coordinator to start additional storage operations and report success after the game closed. Four public-interface cases reproduced false success before the fix.
change: Check disposal after every awaited checkpoint operation before starting another request or acknowledging success. Keep existing ordered/coalesced saves and the two-slot format.
limits: An already-issued storage commit may finish if the adapter ignores cancellation. The intact committed state remains recoverable, while the closed coordinator reports disposed.
Real native/browser host lifecycle and storage qualification remain outstanding. S3-091 remains open.
